limitations.detail: Figure 5b provides MIC bars for native and 100 mM DTT-treated peptide; only M. luteus native 6.3 uM and V. cholerae native 25.4 uM are exact in text, so other MIC rows are marked as approximate visual estimates.
Table 2 residual activity values are source-exact but the indicator strain is not explicitly named in the table; they are retained as stability records, not target-specific MIC rows.
